title: Purchase Order Template
description: Free GST purchase order format for India with PO number, vendor and ship-to details, HSN codes, CGST/SGST, delivery date and terms. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Vendor, bill-to and ship-to blocks with GSTIN
Itemised table with HSN, quantity, rate and GST split
Delivery schedule, payment terms and authorised signatory
useCases: Ordering raw material or packaging from suppliers
Purchase approvals in small and mid-size businesses
research: All references show PO no. and date, buyer and vendor details with GSTIN, ship-to address, item lines with HSN, quantity, rate and tax, total, delivery date, payment and freight terms, and an authorised approval signature.

rows: [Air bubble wrap roll, 1 m x 100 m]

blocks.text: Amount in words: **[Rupees Two Lakh Thirty-Eight Thousand Five Hundred Ninety-Six Only]**

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
text: 1. **Delivery:** deliver to the ship-to address by the date above, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 5 pm. Partial deliveries only with prior approval.
2. **Freight:** door delivery, freight and unloading included in the rates above.
3. **Payment:** within [30 days] of receipt of goods and a correct GST tax invoice, by NEFT.
4. **Invoice:** quote this PO number, our GSTIN and HSN codes on every invoice and delivery challan.
5. **Quality:** goods not matching the agreed specification will be returned at the vendor's cost.
